item.title: Honorverse (1993-)
item.description: The Honorverse, named for the leading character (Honor Harrington), is set in a future where humans have created several star nations across the galaxy, with varied societal norms, forms of government, and trans-star-national factions. Most books, and most series of books, focus on the Manticore star nation’s Navy, and their battles with neighboring powers. Particularly, the main series follows a young office as she assumes her first ship command, and is thrust into the opening salvos of a log awaited conflict. Through the series she is tested, promoted, and returned to the fight time and time again. Honor lives up to her name, and is genuinely a literary character worth more popularity.
